>

>
> Almost none of this scales.
>
> All of this worked until now. But LinkedIn is inconsistent, pure network outreach has a ceiling, and even though referrals are starting to pile up (and will keep being a strong channel), you can't build a growth plan around channels you don't control.

About José Velez (Co-founder & CEO). Product Hunt 2026 Launch Guide | José Velez | 28 comments. # There's a new golden rule on Product Hunt that no one talks about. · 2026-07-29T00:00:00+00:00

There's a new golden rule on Product Hunt that no one talks about.

It cost us our launch ↓

We launched Reach on PH last week. And I fumbled it.

Here's the thing: this wasn't my first launch. With my last company I hit #1 Product of the Day and #2 AI Product of the Month.

So I walked in thinking I knew the game. I didn’t.

I found out the expensive way, mid-launch, watching our upvote count actually drop.

Product Hunt works completely differently now.

Two things actually decide your launch today:

→ Getting featured. Every morning a human on the PH team hand-picks which products show on the homepage. It doesn't matter how many upvotes you have.

→ Best average upvotes per hour across the whole day. Not total upvotes. A product with 500 votes spread evenly beats one with 600 that spiked at 9am and died by noon.

So here's the checklist I wish someone had handed me:
1/ Schedule the launch at least a week in advance. It gives the mods time to see it and pick you as featured. Last-minute launches get buried before anyone sees them.

2/ Get a proven hunter, and line them up before you launch. Find someone who's already hunted a few successful launches and reach out weeks ahead, not the night before. A credible hunter brings a following of active, aged accounts (the votes that actually count) and signals quality to the mods who decide what gets featured.
